exposure: Frozen embryo transfer during natural ovulatory cycle
Frozen embryo transfer during hormone replacement cycle
cohort: Patients who conceived singletons after frozen embryo transfer in Japan in 2013
finding: Patients who conceived singletons after hormone replacement cycle frozen embryo transfer were at increased risk of post-term delivery and Cesarean section compared with those who conceived after natural ovulatory cycle frozen embryo transfer.
mod_finding: Patients who conceived singletons after hormone replacement cycle frozen embryo transfer were at increased risk of post-term delivery and Cesarean section compared with those who conceived after natural ovulatory cycle frozen embryo transfer.
